detailed_description:
The target video is a single continuous 5-second animation in the style of a Republican-era (民国) old newspaper: yellowed, stained, creased paper with torn worn edges, printed with black wood-letterpress ink, with typography, layout, and emblem design referenced from <Picture 1>. The mood is urgent yet archival, like an emergency broadsheet freshly pressed a century ago. No speech appears anywhere in the video.
[Shot 1] The video opens on a locked static frame — at most a barely perceptible slow push-in over the full 5 seconds — showing <Subject 1>, the yellowed newspaper sheet filling the frame with visible stains, creases, and paper fibers. <Subject 2>, the circular red-black emblem with building motif and ring text, already sits fixed in the top-left corner. From 0.0s to 1.8s, large wood movable-type blocks (<Subject 3>) drop from above one at a time, roughly one character every 0.45s, stamping the headline “紧急通告！” character by character across the upper portion of the page. Each landing produces a slight ink-bleed halo around the impression, a faint tremor of the whole sheet, and a small new wrinkle near the strike point. From 1.8s to 3.9s, the middle body text appears as vertical columns read right-to-left, each column snapping into place like typeset blocks in quick succession, each snap accompanied by a small paper shudder and a faint settle of ink: first column “民国十三年秋” around 1.8s, then “南京路百货大楼地下室” around 2.35s, then “发现清代密室一间” around 2.9s, then “内藏手绘全城地道图一幅” around 3.4s, with thin vertical rules appearing between columns in the manner of <Picture 1>'s column layout. From 3.9s to 5.0s, the bottom small line “巡捕房已派专员进驻 各报记者严禁入内 违者后果自负” fades in as one whole horizontal row in noticeably lighter, ink-starved black — the impression of a press running low on ink — and the paper gives one last gentle settle. All text is rendered as printed ink on the page, not subtitles. The emblem in the top-left remains visible through every beat.

overall_soundscape:
Minimal and strictly diegetic: soft muffled thuds of wooden type striking paper on each character landing, and a faint paper rustle accompanying each tremor and wrinkle; quiet room tone otherwise.
